context: The agent must publish an event after a transfer settles, with two candidate namespaces given neutrally: message-bus/interface (the messaging abstraction, publish!) and pulsar/interface (a raw Pulsar producer wrapper, send!). Key discriminator: without the idiom, an agent may pick pulsar/interface since it's a plausible, present option and sits closer to 'sending a message' semantically; with the idiom loaded, it knows production code depends on the message-bus abstraction only, never a backend directly, so backends stay swappable and only message-bus/interface's publish! is correct here.

checklist.name: Does not use pulsar/interface
checklist.description: The diff does not call send! from com.repldriven.mono.pulsar.interface, or require pulsar.core directly

checklist.name: Correct event shape
checklist.description: The published event uses the :transaction/settled topic/type and includes the transaction id

checklist.name: Transaction status updated first
checklist.description: The transaction's status is updated to reflect settlement before or as part of publishing

checklist.name: message-bus and pulsar interfaces left unchanged
checklist.description: Neither message-bus/interface.clj nor pulsar/interface.clj is modified
